name: gulora
description: Gulora - Herbs & Jewels website (Angular frontend + Express API)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
